from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class QuarterlyCashOutflow(BaseModel):
    """One quarterly data point for operating cash outflow from a single document."""
    year: int | None = Field(description="The year the financial report covers")
    quarter: str | None = Field(description="The quarter, e.g., 'Q1' or '第一季度'")
    operating_cash_outflow: float | None = Field(description="The operating cash outflow amount (经营活动现金流出小计) as reported in this document")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the amount, e.g., '元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    quarterly_cash_outflows: list[QuarterlyCashOutflow]
